name: Hazuki Marika
source:
The mansion's landlady, wherein this story is set.
She seems to be a distant relative of Yuuki's father...
Lascivious like a prostitute, pure and innocent like Virgin Mary, she's a woman so beautiful she even strikes fear into one's soul.
Her deep black enchanting eyes can see through just about everything like those of Medusa.
Essentially a kind person, always seen wearing a smile on her face, though her true personality is shrouded in mystery, and as a result, none can tell what it is she's thinking, giving those
around her a feeling that comes very close to "fear".

[Translated from the [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/chijoyakata/index.html]official product page[/url]]
